global_release_conditions.text: Code search shows no production `raw message -> regex parser -> approved` path.
When Hermes is unavailable, the number of new-risk commands is 0.
No FakeAdapter, fixture fallback, or hard-coded account values exist in the Dashboard production build.
Dashboard and Hermes snapshot call only the control-plane API; the API reads only PostgreSQL projections.
Every execution node can independently enter HALTED and REDUCING and write back acknowledgement.
The two accounts' intent, order, position, Redis key, and client order ID never cross.
After replaying duplicate messages, edited messages, WS reconnects, and reconciliation there are no duplicate orders or duplicate fill projections.
Real multimodal (text+image) replay acceptance fully passes.
Binance testnet fully covers: open, partial fill, cancel, stop-loss, scaled take-profit, move-to-breakeven, partial close, full close, restart+reconciliation.
Security check confirms: no test-token fallback, no anonymous watcher write endpoint, no plaintext exchange secrets in the DB, no default live credentials.

Executable gold labels whose final action/instrument/side disagree with Hermes+Gateway (uncertainty must be needs_review).
Trace completeness across all execution events.
Field consistency of Dashboard against projections.
Kill-switch acknowledgement completeness across all nodes.
Automatic new-risk when a node is unreachable or a projection is stale.
